% A guard: cases the fix of KOMA-Script's footnotes must not break.
% scrreprt's default font, with hyperref, and the default \deffootnote,
% whose text starts left of its mark. Each footnote keeps the words and
% spaces of the PDF, whatever its first word.
\documentclass{scrreprt}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\begin{document}
\chapter{First}
Text one.\footnote{I thank a reader for this.}
Text two.\footnote{A measure is finite there.}
Text three.\footnote{We thank the printer too.}
Text four.\footnote[9]{I owe this remark to her.}
Text five.\footnote{a priori it fails.}
\end{document}
